decision.what: Carried the main tree's uncommitted Layers.js, layers.test.mjs and layers-proof.mjs into the worktree as commit 1b6c230c before editing
decision.why: the live Servex runs those uncommitted edits (prompt pause, add_item, amend_bubble); building on the committed file would have dropped them at merge
decision.alternative: edit the committed file and leave the three-way reconcile to the merge

decision.what: A plain page's assistant answers with a new page_reply tool in Layers.js, not card_reply
decision.why: card_reply lives in Assistant.js, outside this fence; page_reply also accepts a card id, so the root pair can answer anywhere
decision.alternative: teach card_reply to accept a page path

decision.what: The 30k/1h resume rule applies to assistants; a manager resumes unless it is at or past its 150k fresh line
decision.why: the owner's rule 3 is about fast assistants; a manager's session is kept for the page's whole life by design

decision.what: A threshold recycle restarts the agent fresh on its NEXT use, not at once
decision.why: it is idle when recycled; starting a process nobody is talking to costs 230 MB for nothing

log.msg: Measured: a fresh card/page assistant began at 56-68k tokens. The account's claude.ai connectors (Figma, Drive, Docs: ~150 KB of tool schemas) and auto-memory load even with settingSources []. Fixed with ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS=false, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1, every other servex tool in disallowedTools, tools [Read, Edit, Write, Bash]: now 10.8k (Sonnet) and 8.1k (Opus root). Bash alone is ~5k of it.

decision.what: Bash stays in the assistant's tools; SERVEX_ASSISTANT_BASH=0 drops it
decision.why: a safe quick edit (the owner's point 5) must commit, run Server/smoke.mjs and Server/merge.mjs in its worktree; without Bash a fresh start would be about 6k
decision.alternative: drop Bash to be under the 10k target, and route quick edits through the manager

log.msg: Found and fixed a latent bug: sync() copied a STOPPED agent's session id back into layers.json on the next sweep, undoing every recycle. It now copies only from running agents.
A redirected PowerShell Start-Process hangs the spawnSync that launched it (the child inherits its pipe); the proof boots Servex with child_process.spawn detached + windowsHide instead.

assign.now: full proof running on the private Servex (6 idle minutes); writing the doc meanwhile

log.msg: Full proof on the private Servex (proof.txt): 3 pages, 694 MB live; at 300 s idle all stopped, 0 claude processes; resume 3.1 s vs warm 2.3 s vs fresh 3.1-3.6 s (Opus root 3.9-4.1 s). Cap run (proof-cap.txt, Bash off): 5 pages -> 4 live, assistant-notes stopped as least recently used; recycled assistant restarted at 6,508 tokens. With Bash (the default) a recycled one restarts at 10,867.

assign.outcome:
**Every page can have its own fast assistant, made on the first message and stopped after 5 quiet minutes.** Proven on a private Servex: three idle assistants held 694 MB, and 0 MB once the 5-minute stop ran; the next message resumed one in 3.1 s (a running one answers in 2.3 s). At most 4 run at once. A fresh assistant now starts at about 11k tokens instead of 60k.
